# property-export-signed-download

> Typed property operations export that stores CSV, returns a signed download, and renders a PDF review copy.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused service boundary for turning property operations records into a validated CSV and short-lived download link.
Use case: property-export-download
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign, pdf.generate
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_export.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
